title: abies durangensis subsp. coahuilensis
intro: Abies durangensis subsp. coahuilensis, commonly known as Coahuila fir, is a plant species belonging to the family Pinaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may aid in the treatment of respiratory issues and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Abies durangensis subsp. coahuilensis include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it a potential remedy for conditions like bronchitis and sore throats. The plant contains bioactive constituents like terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
